title: Recorded Cell Mark Shift
statement: Let $s$ be a natural number, let $f$ assign an optional Boolean value to each integer, and let $h$ be an integer with $|h|\le s$. For each movement $m\in\{-1,0,1\}$, form the ordered list of $2s+1$ cells indexed by $j-s$ for $j=0,\ldots,2s$, with contents $f(j-s)$ and a mark precisely at $h$. The specified scan leaves every cell’s content unchanged and marks precisely the cell indexed by $h+m$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from integers to optional Boolean values
